citation: Coe, Michael D., and Richard A. Diehl. 1980. In the Land of the Olmec. 2 vols. Austin: University of Texas Press. Vol. 1: The Archaeology of San Lorenzo Tenochtitlán (viii + 416 pp.). Vol. 2: The People of the River (vi + 198 pp.). Boxed set with portfolio of fold-out maps. ISBN 0-292-77549-0 (9780292775497).
notes: Primary excavation publication for the Yale University San Lorenzo Tenochtitlán project (southern Veracruz), commonly dated to fieldwork spanning 1964–1970 in secondary literature (eHRAF Archaeology document note, accessed 2026-10-11). Vol. 1 is the site archaeology report; Vol. 2 covers ethnoecology / contemporary riverine communities. Contemporary reviews (American Antiquity; The Americas) confirm two-volume boxed format. Seed cites the work as the foundational San Lorenzo excavation report only; no invented phase calendar or page-level artifact claims. Later absolute-date refinements (e.g. Bayesian models in Inomata et al. 2013) may adjust endpoints — re-check when expanding.
